measurementInterpretation.drawCpu: Renderer.draw capture-to-return duration includes synchronous JS and WebGL/browser calls. It measures submission cost, not completed GPU execution; no gl.finish or GPU synchronization is introduced.
measurementInterpretation.nativeEventWindow: Window capture-to-bubble duration includes the application input handler and any synchronous browser calls, rather than pure sampled JS CPU time.
measurementInterpretation.estimatedInputQueueDelay: Capture timestamp minus the native event timeStamp estimates queue delay. It is recorded separately from handler duration.
measurementInterpretation.eventTiming: Chromium Event Timing separates input delay and event processing for discrete inputs; duration is presentation-aware and quantized. Continuous pointer moves may not appear.
measurementInterpretation.protocolRoundtrips: Playwright mouse roundtrips and the multi-step gesture wait for browser/CDP/compositor acknowledgements. They are not a direct main-thread stall or FPS measurement.
measurementInterpretation.animation: RAF gaps describe headless presentation scheduling, including software GPU/compositor work. Compare them with timer gaps, Long Tasks and event processing; do not interpret RAF alone as JS blocking.
